_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 5 $89FB-$8A6D: the ground-object spawner. The generator for 20-traced.json subtracts these.

regions.name: Ground objects: the row's y
regions.description: GROUND-OBJECT SPAWNER (slot `$802A`, called by the row drawers `$E974` and `$EFF3` after `$83B3` has drawn 16 metatiles): `$14` := (`$E8` + `$AF` - `$B7`) AND `$FF`: the y every object of this row gets (`$AF` is the scroll position within a 16-pixel row, `$B7` the scroll step). RUN: `$AF` = 5, `$B7` = 2 gave y `$EB`. RUN: synthetic row buffers on the labyrinth savestate (bank 5 live): cells with high nibbles 1-7, sets mapped to the three lists.

regions.name: Ground objects: start at cell 15
regions.description: X := 15; the 16 cells of `$04C0-$04CF` are taken from the last to the first (so cell 15 gets the highest free slot).

regions.name: Ground objects: does the cell name an object?
regions.description: `$04C0,X` AND `$F0`: `$83B3` wrote each cell's fifth metatile byte there as (high nibble, set) - the high nibble is the object number within the set's list. Zero: next cell.

regions.name: Ground objects: find the set's object list
regions.description: The low nibble of the cell is the metatile set (0-7); `$0478 + set` (loaded by the scene's set records, `[set | list << 4]`) is the list number 0-2; `$11:$12` := the pointer at `$803C + 2 x list`: `$AF61`, `$AF69`, `$AF71` (8 bytes each); Y := the high nibble.

regions.name: Ground objects: the type
regions.description: The list's byte at Y is the object type; zero means none (next cell); else `$15` := type. RUN: list 0 = `00 31 36 37 3C 75 76 7C`, list 1 = `7D 38 39 3A 3A 3B 3C 3D`, list 2 = `3F 7F 7E 7E 7A 05 03 00`; every spawned type equalled list[set's list][nibble]. RUN: synthetic row buffers on the labyrinth savestate (bank 5 live): cells with high nibbles 1-7, sets mapped to the three lists.

regions.name: Ground objects: a slot
regions.description: `JSR $C027` (`$EA8C`, the allocator: highest free slot 5-23, else reclaim). Carry set (none) ends the WHOLE routine at `$8A6D`, the remaining cells of the row are not tried. RUN: with all 19 slots holding an unreclaimable type nothing changed.

regions.name: Ground objects: type and cell byte
regions.description: Slot field 0 (`$0500,Y`) := the type; field 17 (`$0698,Y`) := the whole cell byte (nibble and set) - the field is the aiming speed class for moving objects and is simply reused here by the ground objects' handlers.

regions.name: Ground objects: band and tile address
regions.description: Field 10 (`$05F0`) := `$AE`, the row index; fields 8 and 9 (`$05C0`, `$05D8`) := the PPU address of the cell's top left tile, `$AD:$AC` + 2 x cell. The handlers use them to patch the background (the cannons' animation through `$AA21`).

regions.name: Ground objects: x
regions.description: Field 2 (`$0530`) := 16 x cell + 8, the cell's centre. RUN: cells 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, 15 gave x `$38 $48 $78 $98 $C8 $F8`.

regions.name: Ground objects: y and attribute address
regions.description: Field 1 (`$0518`) := `$14`; field 11 (`$0608`) := `$AA` + cell / 2, the low byte of the cell's attribute-table address (two cells per attribute byte).

regions.name: Ground objects: return
regions.description: RTS (also the exit when no slot is free).
